snippet.title: From The Dark | Devlog #1 | Entering The Labyrinths
snippet.description:
This is the first full-length devlog in a series that covers a voxel-based dungeon game I'm creating called From The Dark. It's centered around a primary mechanic: being blind. The player can use various items to improve their sight, and fight their way through dungeons full of mythical creatures out to hunt them.

In this video, I'll cover the conception of this title, along with my process of making the first floor in the first area of the game: the Labyrinths. I'll cover how I decided to make this game, how I went about making different systems, several weapons and items, and the first enemies that players might come across.

By the next devlog, many more things will be completed. Majority of the Labyrinths will be done and ready to be shown, there will be a finished player GUI, and potentially the first boss.
